confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate, and two for Lugano prices (a MyLifeElsewhere cost-of-living summary and Expatistan/other listings). Food and drink anchors lean on those crowdsourced aggregates, which vary between pages. Beer (about CHF 6), cappuccino (about CHF 3.8, which I raised for tourist-area cafés) and the inexpensive meal (about CHF 25) are the best supported. The midrange two-person meal is my own estimate. Expatistan gave a cocktail at about CHF 14, but on only eight data points, so I rounded it up slightly. I found no direct wine-by-the-glass price, so I set it at roughly 1.3 times the beer price, based on typical Swiss price relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, using general knowledge of Swiss and Ticino lodging. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation prices. They are the least certain anchors, especially the 1-star and 3-star hotel rooms. I used about 1.25 USD per CHF for conversions, taken from the MyLifeElsewhere figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lugano is a Swiss lakeside tourist city in Italian-speaking Ticino. Its prices run slightly below Zurich and Geneva (cost of living about 10% below the Swiss average), but they are well above neighbouring Italian cities such as Como and Milan.
